title: Replit Shifts to OpenAI as Preferred Partner for AI Agent
summary:
The developer platform's default intelligence engine will move to OpenAI to enhance app-building capabilities and lower operational expenses. CEO Amjad Masad stated that OpenAI's Sol and Astra models perform better than competing options when creating applications from scratch, making them the most efficient choice for powering the company's Agent tool.

This transition follows initial comments at TechCrunch Disrupt where Masad claimed Replit had ended its work with Anthropic, though he later clarified that the platform remains model agnostic. Replit's blog and internal sources indicate that Claude Fable 5 and 5.1 remain in production, while Samuel Spitz of Replit added that OpenAI offers the best cost-per-performance compared to open source models.

selectedTweets.text:
Replit's CEO says they're done with Anthropic. Replit's own blog says otherwise.

Onstage at TechCrunch Disrupt, Amjad Masad said Replit no longer works with Anthropic, and cited cost, partnership and performance. He said OpenAI's Sol and Astra "consistently" do better at building apps from scratch.

But an insider told TechCrunch the partnership is still in place, and a Replit post from late September lists Claude Fable 5 and 5.1 running in production.

So the quote is real. The breakup isn't confirmed yet.
